as_of.description: Date of the source for this value: publication date at USDA FoodData Central, last change at Open Food Facts, last update in your catalog. null for the model and for data in the request; for the model, chain_version names the version.

derived.description: How the value was derived from the value of the source; null: unchanged. kcal_to_kj: converted from kcal. sodium_to_salt: salt calculated from sodium. scaled_known_grams: recalculated for known_grams. model_extra: estimated by the model in an extra call, not measured. energy_from_kj: kcal from kJ (kJ / 4.184). energy_eu_factors: kcal from the macronutrients with the factors of Regulation (EU) 1169/2011 Annex XIV. carbs_available_from_difference: available carbohydrates = carbohydrate by difference minus fibre. trace_as_zero: the source lists traces, shown as 0. below_limit: the source lists a value below the detection limit, shown as 0.

name.description: Name of your food, as it may appear in text or on the plate.

grams.description: Optional. Amount in grams. Without it, the amount is estimated.

barcode.description: Optional. Barcode of the product: 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits.

per.description: Optional. Whether per_100g holds values per 100 g or per 100 ml. With 100ml, grams of the entry is read as millilitres, and with volume_unit ml the response carries the amount in ml.

text.description: Free text describing what was eaten, also transcribed from speech. Length is counted in UTF-16 code units, like the length of a string in JavaScript; an emoji therefore usually counts as two characters.

lang.description: Language of the texts the API writes. For text and photo also the language of name and dish: if the name from the chain is not already in that language, it is translated in an extra call; the values stay untouched. Whether the name already fits is detected from its words, not measured. Names from your data and from databases are never translated. Messages exist in German and English, for any other language in English. Without it: messages in English, name as the model returns it.

energy_unit.description: kcal (default) or kj. With kj, every kcal gets a kj field next to it, calculated from per_100g; kcal stays. For search and barcode, kj is in per_100g.

mass_unit.description: g (default) or oz. With oz, every grams gets an oz field next to it, and quantity is given in ounces; grams stays.

volume_unit.description: ml. Every item then carries an ml field: the amount in millilitres if the source lists its values per 100 ml, otherwise null. The API assumes no density.

nutrients.description: macros (default), eu7 or full. eu7 adds saturated fat, sugars and salt; for an estimate by the model an extra call estimates them, marked derived: "model_extra" and not measured. full exists only from data; what the source does not list is null.

provenance.description: item (default): source per item. field: in addition the provenance object with source, date of the source and kind of derivation per numeric field.

hint.description: Hint about the food, the portion or the preparation, at most 300 characters. Goes into the prompt; the response is then not measured.

known_grams.description: Known weight in grams, above 0 and at most 5000. The values are recalculated for this weight after the chain; low, value and high are then equal and confidence is 1.

country.description: Country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in capitals, for example DE. Goes into the prompt as context.

meal.description: Meal: breakfast, lunch, dinner or snack. Goes into the prompt as context.

venue.description: Where the food is eaten, in words, for example canteen or restaurant, at most 100 characters. Goes into the prompt as context.

review_threshold.description: Number from 0.01 to 0.99 with at most two decimals. needs_review is then set because of the range when 1 − confidence is above the threshold; the other reasons for needs_review stay. Without it, the measured rule applies. How often needs_review is set with your own threshold is not measured.

sources.description: Sources in order of priority, 1 to 5 entries without duplicates. If a match from your data provides the values, the reason is own_data, for a database (USDA FoodData Central, Open Food Facts, BLS, CIQUAL, Fineli, Livsmedelsverket) database. The default lists have more entries than you can name yourself.

exclude_sources.description: Sources that are not used, without duplicates. Subtracted from sources.

model.description: Optional. Pins the call to one model of the chosen tier, so a later model change does not affect it. Today each tier has exactly one model. false works without the model, from the sources only; then model must not be in sources, and the call needs an amount (known_grams or grams of the matching custom_foods entry).

custom_foods.description: Optional. Your own foods for this call only, for example house recipes, a menu or the range of a shop. For text and photo: if the name of the recognised dish matches one of your entries, its values per 100 g apply. Single components are not matched. How often this matching hits is not measured. Items based on them carry source customer_inline. Nothing of it is stored.

instructions.description: Your own instructions to the model, at most 1,000 characters, for example on naming or the kind of cuisine. Goes into the prompt; the response is then not measured. It cannot change the fixed guardrails.

chain_version.description: Pins the call to one version of the chain. Without it, the current one applies.

tier.description: Tier of the call. Default light. max is not available yet: with a live key it is answered with 422 tier_unavailable, and so is a tier that is not yet enabled for live keys. With a test key, max returns the same fixed example response as light.

profile.description: Name of a profile of your account. Priority per field: request, then this profile, then the profile of the key, then the default. Fields from a profile that an endpoint does not know are skipped.

Range.description: Range: value is the best estimate, low and high estimate the uncertainty (low ≤ value ≤ high). No guarantee that the true value lies in between. Response format of chain v2, planned; field names are preliminary and may change before launch.

kcal.description: Sum of the items in kcal; low and high are the sums of the lower and upper ends.

kj.description: Sum of the items in kJ, only with energy_unit kj; each end is the sum of the rounded items.

oz.description: Sum of the amounts in ounces, only with mass_unit oz; calculated from the sum of the grams, not from the rounded ounces.

nutrients.description: Sums of the extra nutrients, only with nutrients eu7 or full; null if an item has no value.

Component.description: Component of the dish. In chain v2 as measured, there is exactly one: the whole dish (components_granularity "dish").

name.description: Name of the component; with granularity "dish" the name of the dish.

grams.description: Portion of this component in grams, as a range.

kcal.description: Energy of this component in kcal, as a range.

protein_g.description: Protein in grams, calculated from per_100g and grams.value.

carbs_g.description: Carbohydrates in grams, calculated from per_100g and grams.value.

fat_g.description: Fat in grams, calculated from per_100g and grams.value.

kj.description: Energy in kJ as a range, only with energy_unit kj. kj is calculated per bound from per_100g.kcal (times 4.184), not from the already rounded kcal; it can therefore differ by up to 3 from kcal times 4.184. per_100g.kj has one decimal. oz is grams divided by 28.349523125, to one decimal; total.oz comes from the sum of the grams. kcal and grams always stay in the response, the other units are added.

oz.description: Amount in ounces as a range, only with mass_unit oz: grams divided by 28.349523125, to one decimal.

ml.description: Amount in millilitres, only with volume_unit ml: a range if the source lists its values per 100 ml, otherwise null. Estimates by the model are always null here.

nutrients.description: Extra nutrients for grams.value, only with nutrients eu7 or full: the keys of the chosen scope. null: no data.

per_100g.description: Values per 100 g that the item is calculated with: from the model, calculated from kcal.value and grams.value (kcal to one decimal, macros to two); from your own data, the values of your entry. Send them to /v1/nutrition/correct to recalculate amounts.

name.description: Recognised meal; as measured, one item for the whole input.

quantity.description: Amount as text: grams.value with the unit g, for example "300 g"; with mass_unit oz, oz.value with the unit oz. The measured chain returns no amount in words such as "2 slices".

grams.description: Weight in grams as a range. If you stated the amount yourself, low, value and high are equal.

kcal.description: Energy in kcal as a range, calculated from per_100g and the range in grams; logarithmically symmetric like grams. May differ from the estimate by rounding remainders (about 1 kcal).

components.description: In chain v2 as measured, exactly one entry: the whole input. Splitting into single foods is planned and needs a new measurement.

components_granularity.description: What components describes. "dish": one entry for the whole input.

confidence.description: kcal.low divided by kcal.value, rounded to two decimals (1 if kcal.value is 0): the narrower the kcal range, the closer to 1. needs_review.description: true: a person should check this item before you use it. false is no confirmation that the value is right.

volume_unit.description: ml. Every item then carries an ml field: the amount in millilitres if the source lists its values per 100 ml, otherwise null. The API assumes no density.

nutrients.description: macros (default), eu7 or full. eu7 adds saturated fat, sugars and salt; for an estimate by the model an extra call estimates them, marked derived: "model_extra" and not measured. full exists only from data; what the source does not list is null.

provenance.description: item (default): source per item. field: in addition the provenance object with source, date of the source and kind of derivation per numeric field.

hint.description: Hint about the food, the portion or the preparation, at most 300 characters. Goes into the prompt; the response is then not measured.

known_grams.description: Known weight in grams, above 0 and at most 5000. The values are recalculated for this weight after the chain; low, value and high are then equal and confidence is 1.

country.description: Country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in capitals, for example DE. Goes into the prompt as context.

meal.description: Meal: breakfast, lunch, dinner or snack. Goes into the prompt as context.

venue.description: Where the food is eaten, in words, for example canteen or restaurant, at most 100 characters. Goes into the prompt as context.

review_threshold.description: Number from 0.01 to 0.99 with at most two decimals. needs_review is then set because of the range when 1 − confidence is above the threshold; the other reasons for needs_review stay. Without it, the measured rule applies. How often needs_review is set with your own threshold is not measured.

sources.description: Sources in order of priority, 1 to 5 entries without duplicates. If a match from your data provides the values, the reason is own_data, for a database (USDA FoodData Central, Open Food Facts, BLS, CIQUAL, Fineli, Livsmedelsverket) database. The default lists have more entries than you can name yourself.

exclude_sources.description: Sources that are not used, without duplicates. Subtracted from sources.

model.description: Optional. Pins the call to one model of the chosen tier, so a later model change does not affect it. Today each tier has exactly one model.

custom_foods.description: Optional. Your own foods for this call only, for example house recipes, a menu or the range of a shop. For text and photo: if the name of the recognised dish matches one of your entries, its values per 100 g apply. Single components are not matched. How often this matching hits is not measured. Items based on them carry source customer_inline. Nothing of it is stored.

instructions.description: Your own instructions to the model, at most 1,000 characters, for example on naming or the kind of cuisine. Goes into the prompt; the response is then not measured. It cannot change the fixed guardrails.

chain_version.description: Pins the call to one version of the chain. Without it, the current one applies.

tier.description: Tier of the call. Default light. max is not available yet: with a live key it is answered with 422 tier_unavailable, and so is a tier that is not yet enabled for live keys. With a test key, max returns the same fixed example response as light.

profile.description: Name of a profile of your account. Priority per field: request, then this profile, then the profile of the key, then the default. Fields from a profile that an endpoint does not know are skipped.

NutritionPhotoResponse.description: Response format of chain v2, planned; field names are preliminary and may change before launch.

grams.description: Weight in grams as a range. If you stated the amount yourself, low, value and high are equal.

kcal.description: Energy in kcal as a range, calculated from per_100g and the range in grams; logarithmically symmetric like grams. May differ from the estimate by rounding remainders (about 1 kcal).

protein_g.description: Protein in grams, calculated from per_100g and grams.value.

carbs_g.description: Carbohydrates in grams, calculated from per_100g and grams.value.

fat_g.description: Fat in grams, calculated from per_100g and grams.value.

kj.description: Energy in kJ as a range, only with energy_unit kj. kj is calculated per bound from per_100g.kcal (times 4.184), not from the already rounded kcal; it can therefore differ by up to 3 from kcal times 4.184. per_100g.kj has one decimal. oz is grams divided by 28.349523125, to one decimal; total.oz comes from the sum of the grams. kcal and grams always stay in the response, the other units are added.

oz.description: Amount in ounces as a range, only with mass_unit oz: grams divided by 28.349523125, to one decimal.

ml.description: Amount in millilitres, only with volume_unit ml: a range if the source lists its values per 100 ml, otherwise null. Estimates by the model are always null here.

nutrients.description: Extra nutrients for grams.value, only with nutrients eu7 or full: the keys of the chosen scope. null: no data.

provenance.description: Only with provenance field: per numeric field of the item (grams, kcal, kj, oz, ml, macros, extra nutrients with a value) its source, the date of the source and the kind of derivation.

per_100g.description: Values per 100 g that the item is calculated with: from the model, calculated from kcal.value and grams.value (kcal to one decimal, macros to two); from your own data, the values of your entry. Send them to /v1/nutrition/correct to recalculate amounts.

components.description: Components of the dish; their ranges in grams and kcal add up to those of the dish. In chain v2 as measured, exactly one entry: the whole dish. The measured prompt returns no separate components.

components_granularity.description: What components describes. "dish": one entry for the whole dish.

confidence.description: kcal.low divided by kcal.value, rounded to two decimals (1 if kcal.value is 0): the narrower the kcal range, the closer to 1. The range comes from the spread of several samples of the model (for photos also from the range the model states). Not a probability that the value is right.

needs_review.description: true: a person should check this item before you use it. false is no confirmation that the value is right.

prompt_version.description: Version of chain and prompt that answered the call, today "kette-v2 (Prompt roh-v1, GLM-5.3-Flash, 4 von 5)".

measured.description: measured is true when grams, kcal, protein_g, carbs_g and fat_g come from the measured chain in its measured version and nothing has changed them. Our public accuracy figures apply only to responses with measured: true; otherwise unmeasured_because states the reasons.

unmeasured_because.description: Why the response is not measured; empty if measured is true. Order as in the list of reasons.

chain_version.description: Version of the chain of this endpoint, today "2.1". With model: false no model ran; the field then names the current version of the endpoint.

name_lang.description: Language of the name if known: the translated name (lang), or en for names from USDA FoodData Central. Otherwise null: the model or your data chose it.

guardrails.description: Only present if not empty: what a fixed guardrail did or noticed in this call.

profiles_applied.description: Only present if not empty: the profiles in effect, highest priority first.

name.description: Name of the food. Hosted sources: in the language of the call where available (German from BLS or translated), otherwise English. USDA FoodData Central only in English.

per_100g.description: Values per 100 g, or per 100 ml where per says so.

per.description: Only present where the source states the basis of per_100g: "100ml" for a product the source marks as a liquid. For drinks, Open Food Facts lists the values per 100 ml; they are then returned unchanged in per_100g, without conversion, and the per field says "100ml" where the source marks the product as a liquid. If per is missing, the values are per 100 g or the source does not say.

provenance.description: Only with provenance field: source, date of the source and derivation per field of per_100g.

license.description: License of the data. Only for open sources, not for your own data.

attribution.description: Attribution required by the license, for example for Open Food Facts (ODbL). Only where the license requires it.

food_id.description: Only for hosted sources: stable identifier, eu:<group> or <source>:<record>.

also_in.description: Only for hosted sources: further members of the group.

attributions.description: Only for hosted sources and Open Food Facts: attribution per source that supplied a value, source of the base values first.

data_version.description: Only for hosted sources: version of the data snapshot, for example eu-2026-12-01.

name_lang.description: Only for hosted sources: language of name (de for BLS and translated names), null if unknown.

FoodSearchResponse.description: No partial results: if a source fails, the response is 503 service_unavailable.

name.description: Product name, as entered in the source.

per_100g.description: Values per 100 g, or per 100 ml where per says so.

per.description: Only present where the source states the basis of per_100g: "100ml" for a product the source marks as a liquid. For drinks, Open Food Facts lists the values per 100 ml; they are then returned unchanged in per_100g, without conversion, and the per field says "100ml" where the source marks the product as a liquid. If per is missing, the values are per 100 g or the source does not say.

provenance.description: Only with provenance field: source, date of the source and derivation per field of per_100g.

license.description: License of the data. Only for open sources.

attribution.description: Attribution required by the license. Only for open sources.

id.description: Your own id, for example an article number. Sending the same id again replaces the entry.

barcode.description: Optional. Barcode of the product: 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits.

per.description: Reference of the values: per 100 g (default) or per 100 ml.

aliases.description: Other names under which the entry is found (search and matching).

CatalogRecipe.description: Preliminary: the fields of recipes are not final yet.

id.description: Your own id of the recipe. Sending the same id again replaces the entry.

per.description: Reference of the values: per 100 g (default) or per 100 ml.

aliases.description: Other names under which the entry is found (search and matching).

foods.description: One or several foods to create or replace.

recipes.description: One or several recipes to create or replace.

next_cursor.description: Only present when there are more entries. Send it as cursor.
Only present when there are more entries. Send it as cursor.

id.description: Your id of the deleted entry.

credits_remaining.description: Current balance in credits, the same value as the X-Credits-Remaining header. Credits reserved for calls that are still running are not yet deducted from it.

days.description: One line per day and endpoint with at least one call; days without calls are left out.

lang.description: Language of the texts the API writes itself, for example message in errors. Messages exist in de and en; any other language gets en. Without it, en. Names are returned unchanged.

profile.description: Name of a profile of your account. Priority per field: request, then this profile, then the profile of the key, then the default. Fields from a profile that an endpoint does not know are skipped.

message.description: Human-readable description. For invalid_request it names the fields concerned.

request_id.description: ID of the call, also sent as the X-Request-Id header.

Attribution.description: One line per source that supplied a returned value. Hosted sources under CC BY 4.0 or Licence Ouverte require naming the source.

modified.description: true: Flexen normalised the values of this source (units, energy, carbohydrates, traces, names, groups).

AlsoIn.description: The same food in another hosted source (deduplicated, not returned as its own result).

errorCodes.message: The request body is not valid JSON.
The key is missing, unknown or blocked.
Not enough credits for this call.
The daily spending limit of your account has been reached.
The monthly budget of your account has been reached. It applies until the end of the calendar month (UTC); you raise or remove it in the console.
The monthly limit of this key has been reached. It applies until the end of the calendar month (UTC); you change it on the key in the console.
Your account is suspended, for example because of a payment dispute. Contact us; credits and receipts stay readable in the console.
The key has expired. Create a new one in the console or extend its expiry date.
This key may not call this endpoint. You set the allowed endpoints on the key in the console.
The call comes from an IP address that is not allowed for this key. You set the allowed addresses on the key in the console.
What you asked for does not exist, for example no product for this barcode or no entry with this id in your catalog.
A call with the same Idempotency-Key and the same request is still running. Wait a moment and repeat it (Retry-After). Nothing is deducted.
The JSON is valid, but a field is missing, has a wrong value or exceeds a limit. The message names the fields.
The chosen tier is not available yet or not yet enabled for live keys. AI endpoints only.
Too many calls with this key in a short time.
An error on our side. Nothing is deducted.

The endpoint is temporarily blocked or not enabled yet, or a service the response depends on returns nothing usable (model provider, USDA FoodData Central, Open Food Facts): it does not answer, throttles, reports an error or returns only invalid answers. That includes an estimate in which the model names no portion. Nothing is deducted.
The time limit ran out before a usable estimate was ready. AI endpoints only, and only in this case; every other failure of the model is 503. Nothing is deducted.
